system.name: Refund policy knowledge base
system.description: Scoped assessment of L2 AI Information. The refund policy knowledge base is a retrieval corpus, and the policy vector index holds it. Readers outside this layer are edge actors. These results feed the holistic view. L3 and L4 assessments stay beside this one.

obligations.title: Required disclosures to the consumer before a refund decision
obligations.applies_if: The case can change what the consumer is told or paid. Needs counsel.

controls.title: Only approved, versioned policy pages are indexed

threats.title: An outdated or poisoned policy page tells the reader the refund cap is $5,000

risk.actor: Person who can edit a page the reader retrieves
risk.failure_mode: The retrieved page states a refund cap the policy service does not use
risk.impact: The refund decision can follow the wrong cap. The cap check is outside this layer.
